race.title: Podkovan Won By A Czech Head Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: This looks a good opportunity for expensive point recruit LASTBUTNOTLEASED to make a winning start for Nicky Henderson. Kaldoun des Rocs and Master Roque head the dangers in an ordinary maiden. LASTBUTNOTLEASED (IRE) KALDOUN DES ROCS (FR) MASTER ROQUE (FR)
